# Week Analysis

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A note summarizing patterns, trends, or review findings across a week's Day Clusters.

## Scope note

Distinguish from WeekIndex (navigation) and from domain-specific analyses like WeekDiabetesAnalysis, scoped specifically to diabetes data.
